title: Tighter CVV Maximum-Load Bound
summary: For CVV honey encryption, the analytical upper bound is 4.094% versus a 2.14% simulation estimate; obtaining a tighter expected-maximum-load bound remains open.

formal_statement.body: Tighten the analytical upper bound on $\mathbb{E}[L]$ for the CVV balls-and-bins instance toward the simulated value $0.0214$.

scope.domain: Probabilistic and combinatorial analysis of the CVV balls-and-bins instance in honey encryption.
parameters: L: maximum load in the CVV balls-and-bins instance
scope.unresolved_remainder: Derive an analytical upper bound on the expected maximum load that is closer to the simulated value 0.0214.

citations.label: Honey Encryption: Security Beyond the Brute-Force Bound

progress.summary: The source reports a 2.14% mean expected maximum load over 100,000 simulation runs, compared with a 4.094% analytical upper bound. It identifies improved bounds as future work.
citation_labels: Ari Juels et al., Honey Encryption: Security Beyond the Brute-Force Bound
